desc: Prove that an optimal sorting sequence can greedily place values \(1,2,\ldots,N\) from left to right.
Derive the exact cost for moving each value across its preceding remaining elements.
Design the \(O(N\log N)\) Fenwick-tree rank/removal algorithm.
Provide a rigorous proof that every required swap is counted exactly once and the total is minimal.
Implement the Python solution with efficient input parsing and 64-bit-safe accumulation.
Validate the formula on samples and edge cases, including sorted, reversed, and shifted-rank permutations.
